entities.name: PMID:25430615
observations: Ferguson AC et al. reported that specific P2X3 receptor inhibition prevented desensitization of P2X-mediated purinergic detrusor contractions in intact rat bladder strips; the effect required intact urothelium.

entities.name: P2X3 blockade prevents desensitization
observations: In rat bladder-strip experiments, P2X3 inhibition prevented desensitization of purinergic detrusor contractions in intact urothelium; urothelial removal eliminated the antagonist effect during EFS.
